title: Geospatial Disaster Simulation on Real Maps: Tile-Aligned Canvas Draping, Elevation Inundation, Three.js Shared WebGL Context, and Feature-State Building Collapse Physics
author: Alex Oliinyk (freeCodeCamp.org / HazardSim; synthesized by Brain Harness)

source.title: How to Build Disaster Simulations on a Real Map: Animated Canvas Layers and Collapsing 3D Buildings with Mapbox GL JS and Three.js

claims.assertion: Ground simulations must be computed in map coordinates rather than screen coordinates; drawing on an overlay screen-space canvas produces visible edges, artificial clipping, and perspective desynchronization when the map tilts or rotates (the 'Sticker Problem').
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'The Core Idea: Map Space, Not Screen Space' (2026)

claims.assertion: Aligning simulation grids to Web Mercator tile pyramids allows direct ingestion and decoding of elevation tiles (AWS Open Data Terrarium or Mapbox Terrain-RGB) into contiguous 1D Float32Array grids without data resampling.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Step 1: Choose a Grid Aligned to Map Tiles' & 'Step 2: Load Real Elevation Into the Grid' (2026)

claims.assertion: Ground fluid textures composite seamlessly over terrain when an offscreen canvas is registered as a map canvas raster source with animate: true, raster-resampling: linear, and raster-fade-duration: 0.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Step 3: Attach a Canvas as a Map Source' & 'Step 6: Layer Video Textures' (2026)

claims.assertion: Mapbox Streets vector tile buildings lack native feature IDs; calling setFeatureState() on vector tiles silently fails. Buildings must be copied into a GeoJSON source with promoteId: 'i' to animate extrusion collapse via feature-state height multipliers without layer rebuilding.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Step 11: Animate Collapse Without Rebuilding Layers' & 'Gotchas: Nothing Happened When I Set Feature State' (2026)

claims.assertion: Foreground 3D structural objects and debris must be rendered via a Three.js custom layer configured with renderingMode: '3d' in Mapbox's WebGL context to share the depth buffer with extruded buildings.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Step 12: A Three.js Scene Inside the Map' (2026)

claims.assertion: Three.js InstancedMesh instanceColor must be pre-allocated for full capacity at initialization; instancing starting at count=0 lazily allocates zero entries, causing all debris instances to render completely black.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Gotchas: Every Instance Was Black' (2026)

claims.assertion: Earthquake camera shaking must be applied via CSS transform to the map DOM container rather than the map camera matrix; camera jitter triggers continuous vector and raster tile re-fetching.
claims.source: Alex Oliinyk: 'Step 15: The Camera Has to Shake' (2026)
